label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect, from Theta.8 and esse-cause priority (inference)
rule: Reductio at the supposed first being: incorruptibility gives act in being, act in being with potency gives composition, composition a distinct cause of esse, distinct-esse-cause priority a prior being, against firstness
meaning: The Theta.8 route (firstBeingNoPotencyOfThetaEight) with the cause-to-efficient-cause bridge and efficient-cause priority replaced by one premise on the q.3 a.7 cause-of-perfection relation: a distinct cause of a thing's esse is simply prior to it. A first being cannot fail to be, so it is in act in being; if it were in potency in some respect it would be composite, hence have a distinct cause of its esse, which is simply prior to it, against firstness. Composes EsseCausePriority.firstBeingNoPotencyOfEssePriority at act in being. The original route applied efficient-cause priority only at that distinct esse-cause instance, so no instance it used is lost. Like the #1604 siblings, it avoids STMT-PERFECTION-CAUSING-IN-ANOTHER-IS-EFFICIENT only because the esse-cause priority premise's upstream bridge covers every CausesIn ... esse instance. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
